title: Bakugan Battle Planet
description: Follow the adventures of Dan Kouzo and his best friends: the first kids on Earth to bond with the mysterious creatures known as Bakugan!

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Dan meets his partner Bakugan Drago for the first time and we learn about the incident that happened on Earth twelve years ago.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Dan and friends win the Bakugan Battle, firmly establishing the Awesome Ones as our heroes and Bakugan Brawlers.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: When the local Burger Joint is being threatened by a rogue Bakugan, Dan steps up to save the day and the burgers!

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The AO stop neighborhood kids from copycat behavior (namely, using their Bakugan for frivolous reasons).

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The AO must handle a neighborhood bully who is using his Bakugan to pick on the local kids.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Wynton's constant practical jokes wear thin on his Bakugan Trox so the Bakugan decide to teach him a lesson.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: After the AO cause accidental destruction Dan's parents question whether the kids should be allowed to keep their Bakugan.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Lia disagrees with her new Bakugan Pegatrix on battle techniques but during a fierce fight Lia must rely on Pegatrix's battle savy.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Two new Bakugan Brawlers, Shun and Magnus, try out for the AO.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The AO solve the mystery of a kid's missing Bakugan and meet a Bakugan Hunter named Strata.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Lightning discovers a new Bakugan, Artulean, leading to an unhealthy rivalry with Howlkor.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: While Lia's newswoman mom does an expose on the AO Strata the Hunter tries to capture Hydorous.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: The AO compete with The Exit, a rival Brawling team for ViewTube hits, leading to a "winner take all" brawl.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: A promotor tries to get the AO to join an official league for Bakugan Battling.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Wynton finds a new Bakugan who proves difficult to control but things get more complicated when Col. Tripp seizes control of Trox.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: With "Dan" behaving strangely toward the AO Lightning sniffs out the truth, an impostor!

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: After a Bakugan field errupts the town kids stampede to get their own Bakugan but when the field is contaminated Lia must save the day.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Dan and Wynton meet a boy who leads them into a maze where the boy's Bakugan has been enslaved.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Philomena Dusk from AAAnimus Corp. hires Magnus and gives him a control implant to bolster the power of his Bakugan to defeat Dan.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: A cryptic call leads the AO in search of a missing Bakugan.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: We are introduced to Shun's mysterious backstory, his relationship with his industrialist father and desire for a closer knit family.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Dan and Shun butt heads on how best to make the AO a real team amidst growing threats.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Drago and the other AO Bakugan face an unseen threat with earth shattering power only to be left wondering if it was all a dream.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Osamu Kazami comes to take his son Shun back home and finds a defiance he hadn't counted on.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: AO meet Benton Dusk discovering that their quiet little corner of the world is about to become larger.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: Benton Dusk reveals AO have been identified as persons of interest by powerful corporations including Philomena Dusk's AAAnimus.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: AO embark on a mission into the mysterious labyrinth world of Vestroia to find Strata the Hunter and free the Bakugan he has imprisoned.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: The AO encounter powerful forces that seem to be struggling for control over the alien landscape.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: AO experience mind altering effects of the nearby Core Cell and come face to face with the Bakuzon monster Tiko.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: The AO find the doorway out of Vestroia only to learn they have entered a mirror world of their own imagining.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: Drago leads the Bakugan against the threat of Tiko to protect a powerful energy source.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: The AO defend the Core Cell from an attack by Tiko and in a last ditch effort to save it Dan manages to evolve Drago into his L2 form.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: AO return home to learn that no time has passed but they soon discover their knowledge of brawling has gotten years advanced.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: After Strata is sent packing the AO discover that they have picked up a hitchhiker a Panda-like Bakugan.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: AO want to evolve their Bakugan like Dan did with Drago but only Shun finds a way by tapping into the energy of the Mind Core Cell.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 36
episodes_data.description: Shun's cousin claims Hydorous as his intellectual property the AO must battle to keep their friend.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 37
episodes_data.description: Confronted by China, Riot Lia learns to evolve Pegatrix after realizing the true meaning behind her filming obsession.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 38
episodes_data.description: Dan tries to lie about evolving Drago and gets exposed while the team face off against Duran Dane and his Bakugan.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 39
episodes_data.description: Dan and Wynton stumble on both a possible hidden location and Colonel Tripp who wants the energy source for himself.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 40
episodes_data.description: After a falling out with Dan, Wynton is mind-controlled by Tripp who stages an attack to ignite a war.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 41
episodes_data.description: Dan embarks on a solo adventure to outdo Magnus's new team of Bakugan Brawlers.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 42
episodes_data.description: Lightning uncovers the Mind Core Cell buried beneath the Earth and battles Stata the Hunter in an effort to protect its secret.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 43
episodes_data.description: Lightning reveals his discovery of the Mind Core Cell but the AO arrive only to discover that Magnus has already beaten them to it.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 44
episodes_data.description: Both team's Bakugan knocked into a hibernation state by the Mind Core Cell!

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 45
episodes_data.description: After defeating Magnus the AO get an offer of employment from a surprising source Philomena Dusk!

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 46
episodes_data.description: During a commercial to celebrate their joining the AAAnimus team Dan and the AO rebel before they sellout.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 47
episodes_data.description: While escorting the Mind Core Cell to AAAnimus Campus the AO are attacked by Masato Kazami and his Body Guards.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 48
episodes_data.description: Philomena's attempt to refocus the Mind Core Cell's power backfires and the AO must fight their fellow employees.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 49
episodes_data.description: After more unsuccessful attempts to harness Core Cell energy the AO must battle their own Bakugan with AAAnimus tech in order to save them.

episodes_data.title: Bakugan Battle Planet Season 1 Episode 50
episodes_data.description: The AO confront Philomena with concerns about her control over the Core Cell energy.
